statement: In 2024 Intel announced roughly 15,000 job cuts in August and a USD 10bn savings target, reported a quarterly loss near USD 10bn in Q3 2024, and its shares fell by more than half over the year; the company said it would keep investing in Arizona, Oregon, New Mexico and Ohio.
note: Aggregated reporting only; figures should be re-verified against Intel's filings before any load-bearing use.
